title: UPI concepts, IDs and QR payments - support procedure
content: For a safe demonstration, inspect the displayed recipient and amount before approving a fictional QR payment or request. This prototype explains the flow but does not initiate a real payment, scan payment credentials or ask for a UPI PIN.
